import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    w=p[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t); e=np.exp(-t)
    return p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*t**2+p[3]*e+p[4]*t*e+p[5]*np.sqrt(P)+p[6]*P*s+p[7]*e*s+p[8]*c
